newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends up in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends up in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended higher against New York's Monday close after very quiet trade, bullion traders said on Tuesday.
Bullion ended at US$368.90/369.40 an ounce Tuesday against New York's US$368.60/369.10 close on Monday.
Gold dealers said the market moved up on physical bargain hunting and some shortcovering prior to the Christmas holiday.
Hong Kong's gold markets will close on December 25 and December 26 for Christmas and will reopen December 27.
Local gold ended HK$4 higher at HK$3,408 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver
Exchange Society rose to -3.00 from its previous fix at -6.00.
